summary: Phase 10 Notification System end-to-end verification. Backend: ran /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py — 14/14 pytest cases pass in 5.98s (VAPID key, prefs default/update, checkin-nudge category+master gates, invalid trigger, daily cap, tick idempotency, audience gating, mark opened/dismissed, push subscribe upsert+unsub, admin CRUD + analytics, input validation, unauth 401). Frontend: Playwright verified full flow on admin login. Bell renders in Dashboard header with unread badge (4). Panel opens with 4 seeded feature_announcement notifications (>=3 requirement met). notification-item-<id> + notification-dismiss-<id> testids present; dismiss removes item and decrements badge (4->3 verified). Clicking a card fires POST /me/notifications/<id>/opened (network captured) and closes panel. 'Read all' fires POST /me/notifications/read-all and badge disappears. Bell footer link and account-menu-notifications both open notification-preferences-modal. All 5 category toggles present (feature_announcement/checkin/recommendation/session_reminder/harmonic_blueprint); toggling persists via PUT /me/notifications/prefs and updates aria-checked. Quiet-hours toggle hides start/end selects when off, shows when on; changing values persists via PUT. Daily-max dropdown change persists; disabled when master off. Master toggle off correctly disables category rows and max-per-day select (disabled attr present). Push enable button is present when master is on and disabled when master off. Push subscription click did NOT flip to 'Turn off push' in headless Playwright — this is the environmental limitation flagged in the request; no PUT went out because pushManager.subscribe likely rejected due to missing service worker / VAPID env in headless. Post-session checkin-nudge trigger and audience-pro gating verified via backend pytest (not exercised through UI to avoid 60s audio playback).

integration_issues.issue: In headless Playwright with permission granted, clicking notif-prefs-push-enable does not transition to notif-prefs-push-disable — no PUT push_enabled=true observed. Likely pushManager.subscribe fails (no SW / VAPID in headless preview). Environmental — request notes to log as INFO and skip. Recommend gating with visible error state so real users see a hint if subscribe fails silently.

issues: Wellness Assistant auto-greet sheet centered overlay overlaps notification panel on right; users clicking bell right after login may see the assistant obscure the panel until dismissed. Consider z-order or auto-close when the bell/panel opens.

action_items: Consider surfacing a user-visible error in NotificationPreferencesModal when subscribeToPush returns a non-ok reason other than 'unsupported'/'denied' (already partially done — verify the 'We couldn\'t enable push notifications right now.' branch fires in headless).
Optional: auto-dismiss / lower z-index of Wellness Assistant sheet when NotificationBell panel is opened so first-login users can reach the panel without pressing Escape first.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx handleOpenItem: `n.opened_at` truthiness at click time is compared, but the local optimistic update sets opened_at just after. Subtraction guard `n.opened_at ? 0 : 1` is correct since we check the incoming prop before mutation — good.

NotificationPreferencesModal deep merge for categories works but only merges the ONE key patched via savePartial({categories:{[key]:v}}). Ensure server also does partial-merge and does not clobber other category keys. Backend pytest test_prefs_default_and_partial_update presumably covers this — verify.
Dashboard.jsx is now >2350 lines (was 2100 in iter57). Growing tech debt — split header (bell + account menu) into a DashboardHeader component.

TogglePill button lacks data-testid on the inner span thumb but the outer button carries testid — fine, but consider adding an accessible label since the parent label wraps a div rather than the input.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all UI-testable flows pass; push subscribe flip cannot be exercised in headless — environmental)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded feature_announcement notifications delivered via /me/notifications/tick on Dashboard mount (4 items observed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 notification system is fully green on backend (14/14 pytest) and frontend UI flows (bell/panel/dismiss/mark-all/prefs modal/category toggle/quiet hours/max-per-day/master disable/account-menu entry all verified). Only untested UI path is the actual push subscription flip in headless — verify manually in a real browser with a service worker or accept as environmental. Wellness Assistant auto-greet overlay can intercept bell clicks on first login of the day — use JS click via page.evaluate to bypass, as noted in the original request. Preferences modal can be reached via either notification-open-preferences (bell footer) or account-menu-notifications (account dropdown); both were verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Push-subscribe flip failure in headless is environmental, not a code defect.
